source:
Meet Yukawa Reona, a genius with a brain like a supercomputer.
He's shy, awkward, and the kind of guy who disappears in a crowd, but he's got a hopeless crush on one girl.
Unfortunately, her type is tall guys.
"If I don't do something, I'll never be Shizu-nee's man! Gotta get taller, no matter what!"
Using his big brain, he cooks up "Senobitan Z"--a crazy growth serum that's supposed to make him shoot up like a weed.
But when he drinks it... he gets a weird side effect. Instead of getting taller, he shrinks into a kid, but only when he gets turned on.
And that's not all! Every time he nuts, he grows back... and gains a tiny bit of height.
Now, stuck in his "kid mode," he's accidentally triggering every woman's mommy instincts seducing busty babes and knocking them up left and right!
The baby-making spree starts now!

translation:
来认识一下汤川丽娜吧，她是一位拥有超级计算机般大脑的天才。
他害羞、笨拙，是那种消失在人群中的人，但他却无可救药地迷恋着一个女孩。
不幸的是，她喜欢的类型是高个子男生。
“如果我不做点什么，我就永远不会成为志姐的男人！不管怎么样，我都要长高！”
他用他的大大脑调制出了“Senobitan Z”——一种疯狂的生长精华液，可以让他像杂草一样生长。
但当他喝了它之后……他得到了一种奇怪的副作用。他不但没有长高，反而缩小成一个孩子，但只有在他兴奋的时候。
这还不是全部！每次他发疯的时候，他都会重新长出来……并且身高会增加一点点。
现在，他陷入了“孩子模式”，不小心触发了每个女人的妈妈本能，引诱丰满的美女，并把她们左右摇晃！
生孩子的狂欢现在开始了！
